delta.comment: Two-axis gate disposition: size=S (well under the 2-hour rule) but complexity=high, which mandates a split or an explicit de-risking step. Resolution: NOT split -- the migrate --workspace-dir invocation is atomic and cannot be decomposed without creating a partial-migration window, which is the exact dual-root fail-closed hazard this plan exists to prevent. Instead, three dedicated de-risking tasks precede it and are wired as hard blockers: 129.003-T (rollback runbook committed BEFORE the irreversible step), 129.004-T (verified out-of-tree backup + H1 idle gate), and 129.005-T (proven lock release + reviewed dry-run). The residual uncertainty is further bounded by H13 (the SQLite index is derived state, rebuildable via backlogit sync from Markdown) and by the empirically verified BACKLOGIT_WORKSPACE_DIR escape hatch (H10). Complexity remains recorded as high so the signal is not laundered away by the mitigation.

CORRECTION 2026-08-17 (post-Orchestrator review; appended, prior provenance preserved). The automatic rollback (delete .backlog + git checkout -- .) is WITHDRAWN as a P1 defect on two independent grounds. (1) UNAUTHORIZED BREADTH: general authorization to perform the migration does not silently authorize destroying a storage root or resetting the whole worktree after a failure; git checkout -- . also reverts unrelated tracked work, violating surgical preservation. (2) PROVABLY INCORRECT: .backlogit is git-tracked (E1, 1613 files), so after the rename git checkout -- . restores .backlogit from HEAD while .backlog still exists on disk -- MANUFACTURING the exact dual-root state H10 exists to prevent. The prescribed recovery would have caused the failure it was meant to cure. Replaced by new hardening H16: (1) set a VERIFIED BACKLOGIT_WORKSPACE_DIR override (exactly .backlog/.backlogit, existing, real directory, not symlink/reparse) restoring tooling without touching the filesystem; (2) PRESERVE both roots and the backup; (3) RECORD EVIDENCE; (4) HALT for EXPLICIT OPERATOR APPROVAL of any deletion or restoration. Absolute prohibitions: never auto-delete a root, never broad git checkout -- . or whole-worktree reset, never guess root authority. Any future approved rollback targets an ENUMERATED PATHSPEC LIST plus a named source/destination copy-back only; pathspec-less and wildcard forms stay forbidden even after approval. migrate --rollback remains secondary, unverified (H9) and operator-gated. Also added: mandatory pre-flight re-assertion of the 129.004-T backup immediately before the irreversible step. Correction-pass review verdict: PASS, 0 P0, 0 P1.
